name: Crypto-Agility Assessment
description: Assessment of an organisation's ability to transition between cryptographic algorithms, with emphasis on post-quantum migration readiness. Covers cryptographic inventory, algorithm negotiation flexibility, migration planning, hybrid deployment evaluation, and harvest-now-decrypt-later risk assessment.

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands the quantum threat timeline and why crypto-agility matters
evidence: Can explain the harvest-now-decrypt-later threat model
Understands what crypto-agility means and why organisations need it
Can describe the NIST post-quantum standardisation timeline and key milestones

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Assists with cryptographic inventory and migration readiness assessment under supervision
evidence: Inventories cryptographic algorithms in use across systems using scanning tools
Identifies quantum-vulnerable key exchange algorithms (RSA key transport, ECDH) and signature algorithms (RSA, ECDSA), and understands the different urgency profiles for each, under guidance
Documents crypto-agility findings following lab templates
Assists in mapping cryptographic dependencies across the technology stack

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses crypto-agility and post-quantum migration readiness
evidence: Produces comprehensive cryptographic inventories across enterprise environments
Evaluates algorithm negotiation mechanisms for upgrade flexibility
Assesses harvest-now-decrypt-later exposure for data-at-rest and data-in-transit

Produces migration readiness reports referencing CNSA 2.0 timelines, NIST IR 8547 (draft) transition dates (quantum-vulnerable algorithms deprecated after 2030, disallowed after 2035), and NIST SP 1800-38 (draft) guidance

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex crypto-agility assessments; develops migration strategies
evidence: Develops phased post-quantum migration roadmaps for enterprise environments
Evaluates hybrid classical/post-quantum deployment strategies for transition period
Assesses crypto-agility in legacy systems with hard-coded or non-negotiable algorithms
Reviews and mentors junior staff on crypto-agility assessment methodology

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines crypto-agility assessment methodology; recognised authority on cryptographic migration
evidence: Authored or maintains the lab's crypto-agility assessment methodology
Published research on post-quantum migration strategies or crypto-agility frameworks
Provides expert guidance to organisations on quantum readiness and transition planning
Trains teams on crypto-agility assessment, migration planning, and emerging standards

assessment_methods.description: Perform a crypto-agility assessment of an enterprise environment: inventory cryptographic usage, identify quantum-vulnerable systems, and produce a prioritised migration readiness report
Given an organisation with mixed cryptographic deployments, develop a phased migration plan addressing harvest-now-decrypt-later risk for high-value data
